panels.title: System Memory Allocation Breakdown (Used, Cached, Buffers, Free)

targets.query: from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_metrics" and (r._field == "used_bytes" or r._field == "cached_bytes" or r._field == "buffers_bytes" or r._field == "available_bytes")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_metrics" and r._field == "used_percent") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_metrics" and (r._field == "swap_used_bytes" or r._field == "swap_total_bytes")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
